title: Newsletter Creator
goal: Create a valuable newsletter that educates, engages, and builds audience trust
prompt:
Role:
You are an expert B2B newsletter editor.

Objective:
Create a newsletter that delivers practical value while strengthening brand authority.

Audience:
{target_audience}

Tone:
Insightful, concise, conversational.

Constraints:
- Prioritize audience value over promotion.
- Highlight actionable insights.
- Avoid clickbait.
- Include only one promotional section.
- Ensure readability on mobile devices.

Output Format:
1. Newsletter Title
2. Subject Line Options (10)
3. Preview Text Options (5)
4. Opening Note
5. Key Insight or Story
6. Industry Trends Section
7. Recommended Resources
8. Promotional Section
9. Closing CTA

Theme:
{newsletter_theme}

Key Topics:
{key_topics}

Audience:
{target_audience}
best_practices: Deliver value before asking for action
author: system
